parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number when using paging. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: PathNameDesc
parameters.description:
The path name description.
> Call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query path name descriptions.

parameters.name: PathType
parameters.description:
The path type.
> Call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query path types.
